neighbours.label: the verb 'need' (need/needed; Chinese 需要)
fire: After the storm, the town needed more workers to clear the roads.
For the trip, we needed two extra tents and a stove.
Before winter, the farmers needed to repair every fence.
In the end, the patients need to rest for a full week.
今年的冬天，我们还需要更多的燃料。
这个城市需要更多的医生和护士。
学生们需要在周五之前交作业。
Last year, the team needed a new coach to turn things around.
quiet: After the storm, the town hired more workers to clear the roads.
For the trip, we packed two extra tents and a stove.
Before winter, the farmers wanted to repair every fence.
In the end, the patients have to rest for a full week.
今年的冬天，我们买了更多的燃料。
这个城市有很多医生和护士。
学生们必须在周五之前交作业。
Last year, the team found a new coach to turn things around.
